Kit summary

Feather DanceBasic
Deals 100% ATK DMG and 100% ATK [Bleed] DMG to a single enemy, with a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns.
Fortune BlessingsActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Grants [Consolidation Ⅱ] on all allies for 2 turns.
Holy Light Feather Lv.2After Grace casts Fortune Blessings or Sacred Feather Array proactively, tosses feathers of the same quantity as that of [Spirit Feather] layers owned by self to attack enemies randomly. Each feather deals 1 stage of 150% ATK DMG and 150% ATK [Bleed] DMG to the target. If the same target is hit multiple times during a single cast, the DMG taken at each stage is equal to 90% of the previous stage. When the same target is hit by 10 times or above during a single cast, there is a 100% chance to reduce the target's Crit DMG by 60% for 2 turns.
Holy Light Feather Lv.3At the beginning of Grace's turn, she gains 1 layer of [Spirit Feather]. When self owns 5/10/15 layers of [Spirit Feather], gains the following additional effects: 5 layers: At the beginning of Grace's turn, cleanses 1 random layer of debuff from all allies. 10 layers: Fortune Blessings also grants all allies a [Shield] equal to 25% of Grace's Max HP for 3 turns. 15 layers: Sacred Feather Array also refreshes the duration of all allies' attribute buffs.
Sacred Feather's BlessingPassiveExclusive Lv.1
At the beginning of Grace's turn, grants all allies 1 layer of [Gleaming Feather]. When an ally with [Gleaming Feather] inflicts [Bleed] successfully, [Gleaming Feather] will convert into [Spirit Feather] and be transferred to Grace. [Spirit Feather]: Each layer increases Grace's [Bleed] DMG dealt by 1.4% of no more than 200% of her initial Mastery, up to 20 layers, and won't be removed upon death.
Holy Light Feather Lv.1At the beginning of the battle, increases Grace's Healing Effect by 35% of her initial Mastery, up to 70% additional Healing Effect can be gained in this way. Also, at the beginning of an ally's turn, restores the ally's HP by 6% of their HP if Grace survives. For every 1 layer of [Spirit Feather] owned by Grace, additionally restores the ally's HP by 0.8% of their Max HP.
Sacred Feather ArrayActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Restores all allies' HP by 12% of their Max HP and increases their Effect Hit by 50% for 2 turns. Also, all allies (excluding self) will own the same number of layer(s) of [Spirit Feather] as Grace.
